checks.evidence: ADR-0001 and domain/API/browser/distributed tests keep shared gameplay and hidden state server-authoritative
Automated forbidden-import checks protect domain, store, and pure browser game modules
ADR-0002, revision CAS, fencing, service-backed tests, and restore drills establish PostgreSQL authority
ADR-0003 plus immutable protocol, migration, balance, replay, and mixed-release gates
Every critical repository file maps to exactly one boundary, role, CODEOWNERS account, and review rule

findings.title: Large application, store, domain room, and route modules need responsibility-based decomposition
findings.acceptance: Room/state-machine, timer/recovery, matchmaking, presentation, chat, moderation/live-content, metrics, and orchestration boundaries are independently testable and the separate AAA decomposition gate passes

findings.title: Public account-deletion response currently exposes a store-owned statistics DTO
findings.acceptance: Transport response DTO owns its public shape and maps from a storage result without making protocol code depend on store implementation types
